The proposed reference map is not valid over \(\mathbb Q\) or any characteristic-zero finite extension. Its Jacobian determinant is nonconstant:

\[
\det J_F(0,0,0)=-2,
\]

whereas at \((1,1,1)\),

\[
J_F(1,1,1)=
\begin{pmatrix}
25&53&8\\
42&94&12\\
-7&-3&-1
\end{pmatrix},
\qquad
\det J_F(1,1,1)=580\ne -2.
\]

The construction is instead valid in characteristic \(3\): modulo \(3\), its determinant is identically \(-2=1\). Since every allowed field here has characteristic zero, the hint cannot yield the requested certificate. A genuine characteristic-zero certificate would disprove the open complex Jacobian Conjecture, so no valid `map_collision` JSON can be supplied from the stated construction.
